pb-translation.title: Translation and subtitles
pb-translation.intro: Keep the source beside every translation. Review meaning before the client approves.
pb-translation.languageHelp: For example, en for English or hi for Hindi.
pb-translation.sourceHelp: Separate document blocks with a blank line. Keep names, codes and numbers in the source.
pb-translation.subtitleHelp: One timed sentence per line: start in milliseconds | end in milliseconds | source text.
pb-translation.privacy: Private jobs use local manual review. A local AI connector is planned.
pb-translation.unknown: Model language support is unknown. Check your service documentation.
pb-translation.rightsNote: Legal certification and public translation services await review. No client text is sent by this sheet.
pb-translation.termHelp: One pair per line: source term => preferred translation.
pb-translation.glossaryReview: Review these terms, even when the glossary is empty.
pb-translation.meaningHelp: Code checks structure and protected facts. You must check meaning, names and negation in both languages.
pb-translation.meaningCheck: I reviewed every source and translated block.
pb-translation.unsaved: Save your edits before approving or exporting.
pb-translation.evidence: Approval evidence for this exact version
pb-translation.exportHelp: This saves the approved text locally. Send it to the client yourself. PDF needs the desktop app and a Hindi font.
pb-translation.saved: Download prepared. Check your saved file.
pb-translation.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This action could not finish. Review your inputs and try again.
pb-translation.error.PRIVATE_NEEDS_LOCAL: This private job needs a local model. Use the local review sheet meanwhile.
pb-translation.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The job changed. Review it again.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_CHECK_F: Fix the marked source, translation or subtitle timing first.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_APPROVA: Review the exact translation with the client first.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_INPUT_I: Check the source blocks, language codes and required fields.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_TIMING_: Keep timed sentences in order without overlap.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_REPAIR_: Keep every source block and a nonempty translation.
pb-translation.error.RIGHTS_REQUIRED: Record ownership or a licence allowing translation at intake.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_EXISTS: Open the saved translation job for this order.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_NOT_FOU: Choose a translation job in this business.
pb-translation.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQ: Check the required fields and try again.
pb-translation.check.TRANSLATION_REPAIR_: A source block is missing or empty.
pb-translation.check.TRANSLATION_PROBE_M: A protected source fact is missing.
pb-translation.error.DERIVED_STALE: The source transcript changed. Replace the source and review again.
pb-translation.replaceHelp: This clears the old translations, notes and approvals. Review the new source before continuing.
pb-translation.aiHelp: Your configured AI receives this source and locked glossary only after you approve the exact request. Owner edits stay protected.
pb-translation.clientLinkHelp: Create a hosted review link for this exact translation. The client must approve through that link. Send the link yourself. Desktop-only sharing stays planned until a hosted address is connected.
pb-translation.error.SHARE_NOT_HOSTED: Client review links need hosted Chausar with a public address.
pb-translation.error.TRANSLATION_CLIENT_: The client must approve this exact translation through its review link.
pb-translation.error.NO_MODEL_CONNECTED: Connect an AI in Your AI first.
pb-translation.check.TRANSLATION_SOURCE_: The source needs correction. Ask the client before translating.
pb-translation.probeHelp: One name or code per line, copied exactly from this source. Numbers are already checked.
pb-translation.deliveryPlanned: Client delivery is planned until a lawyer confirms the translation-rights rule. Prepare and review the local draft meanwhile.
pb-translation.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: Client delivery is planned until a lawyer confirms the translation-rights rule. Prepare and review the local draft meanwhile.
